blocks.name: inference
blocks.description: Provider-agnostic model resolution with EU/sovereign targets and a fail-closed active-target chooser.

blocks.name: rag
blocks.description: Portable retrieval pipeline (ingest → chunk → embed → index → cited retrieval) with a provider-free core and a one-command repo/KB CLI.

blocks.name: guardrails
blocks.description: Security primitives: reversible PII masking, per-principal spend/rate caps over an injected store, and untrusted-content fencing + an advisory injection detector. Zero dependencies.

blocks.name: settings
blocks.description: Runtime operator-editable config: typed setting resolved env-override → stored value → default, with a short cache (live after a write) and fail-safe decoding. Store + env injected. Zero dependencies.

blocks.name: router
blocks.description: Classify a query into a tier (light/standard/deep) to pick which model answers: deterministic rules first, then an optional injected LLM classifier, then a safe default. Fail-safe. Provider-free core + AI SDK classifier adapter.

blocks.name: verify-correct
blocks.description: Check a generated answer is grounded in its sources and correct it if not, in a bounded verify/correct loop. Provider-free core (judge/corrector/generate injected), fail-safe. AI SDK judge+corrector adapter.
